registered_before: the P5-N2 measurement audit and before any P5-N2 run is scored; no P5-N2 fit quality has been seen (all runs so far had measured targets removed). Known when registered: the blind state envelope showed chemistry-untrustworthy states (T_e > 30 eV) in every run of sgb-screen-02/03/04 and 9 runs of sgb-screen-05 under the pre-promotion 0.10 chemistry.
part_of: the P5-N2 scoring pre-registration (acceptance criteria and escalation triggers are registered separately, after the measurement audit)

run_status.PASS: numerically valid (converged, sustained) AND chemistry_trustworthy AND every pre-registered experimental criterion met
run_status.FAIL_VALIDATION: numerically valid AND chemistry_trustworthy, but a pre-registered experimental criterion is missed (a validation failure for that criterion)
run_status.OUT_OF_DOMAIN: numerically valid but NOT chemistry_trustworthy: NOT SCOREABLE - OUTSIDE CHEMISTRY MODEL DOMAIN; no P5 score is computed. This is not evidence against the candidate: the chemistry model has left the domain in which it was agreed to be trusted
run_status.NUMERICAL_FAILURE: not converged, not sustained, or solver error

candidate_status.rule: Promotion of a screening candidate (sgb-screen-*) into the admitted Hall closure set requires scoreable runs at EVERY pre-registered P5-N2 operating point under EVERY mandatory chemistry configuration, and the pre-registered acceptance criteria on those runs.
candidate_status.not_all_mandatory_runs_scoreable: INCONCLUSIVE / NOT ELIGIBLE FOR PROMOTION in this campaign; the candidate stays a screening hypothesis and is NOT rejected as physically invalid
candidate_status.validation_failure: decided by the acceptance criteria registered after the measurement audit

staged_sensitivities_note: not mandatory for admission; run and escalated under the triggers registered with the acceptance criteria

chemistry_trust_rule.note: The f_out = 0 rule (reaction-weighted activity beyond a table's validity limit, every saved frame and cell) was fixed before this validation and is NOT relaxed for scoring, whatever the extrapolated fraction. Extending the chemistry domain would be a separate model change with its own evidence and reruns, never a scoring accommodation.
